label: FTS supported query types
type: scheme, first promoted this round despite 16+ extraction-layer members accumulated since round 2 - a real backlog item nobody had crossed the bar on before now. Each query type is filed as fts:fts-supported-queries-<kebab-name>; members promoted separately as they clear the bar.
note: 12 further members remain unpromoted at 1 file each (match, match-phrase, boolean-field-query, date-range, fuzzy, geopoint-spatial, ip-range, numeric-range, prefix-query, query-string-query, regexp, wildcard, term-query, term-range) - real query types, just not yet independently attested a second time. Not a page-id defect like search:'s create-*/set-*/child-field-* ids: each of these names an actual SQL++-adjacent query-clause type, not a page's own task.
relates_to_competency_question: What are all the query types a Search index request can express?
